en.dr-ali-peiravi: According to the same documentation, God’s Prophet (S) said, “Pulpits will be set up on the Resurrection Day around the Throne for my followers and the followers of the members of my Household - those who are sincerely our friends. The Honorable the Exalted God will say,“O My servants! Rush to me so that I can bestow upon you My Nobility as you experienced much harm in the world.”
